tool_input.description: Preview can_advisor data and row count
tool_input.sql:
SELECT count(*) as total_advisors,
       count(team_name) as with_team,
       round(avg(total_aum), 2) as avg_book_aum,
       round(avg(client_count), 1) as avg_clients
FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_CANONICAL.CAN_ADVISOR
